implementation.registration: Optional report_finding.reproduction: entry_point, prerequisites, ordered steps. Each step requires title/action/result; optional proves, request/response, command/output, traffic_refs. Up to 50 steps/50 prerequisites and 1MiB JSON; unknown fields and model-supplied binding_ids rejected. Original evidence remains compatible.
implementation.persistence: Nullable findings.reproduction JSONB via existing schema startup; same transaction saves both standalone finding and exploration payload after exact binding resolution. Failed resolution rolls back provisional findings, nodes, anchors and bindings. Immutable after registration.
implementation.authorization: Existing role, asset, task, intent and suppression checks preserved. Step traffic uses explicit verified IDs, converts to finding-owned stable binding IDs, requires local/direct-source asset registration and current role approval under the asset lock. No matching by time/domain/content. Host comparison here is authorization only. No host query for non-traffic steps.
implementation.reports: Reporter uses saved steps first and directed history reads only for missing details. Existing Reporter and model calls reused. Five report sections and remediation <=50 Chinese characters retained. Fixed assembly guidance also reaches custom prompts, and only the exact previous default gets upgraded.
implementation.compatibility: No history backfill, no rewriting of existing reports or audit history, no screenshots/upload feature, no Word/PDF, no report progress UI. Existing task lifecycle, manual mode and Worker dispatch unchanged.
implementation.read_export: Only detail/export load reproduction; regular/task list projections remain small. JSON export includes reproduction. Markdown uses a deterministic saved-step fallback only when report is empty. Existing evidence ZIP attachments and version guards retained. Archive restore handles old missing fields; task deletion may preserve standalone steps.
implementation.frontend: One shared panel used by global findings, task findings, standalone detail. Natural-language descriptions expanded; raw packets/commands collapsed and copied independently. Evidence body viewer mounts only on explicit click; no new network requests merely for step display.

The sample report is the deterministic no-Reporter fallback generated by the production renderer from synthetic evidence, not a new vulnerability finding.
